|strategy=By Eric Olson<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/tatooinel.html</ref>

Have you had enough of the old boring [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] system? Then check out this card. While the power bonuses from the old [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] may be useful sometimes, this version is more versatile. No matter what deck you have, whether it's [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers{{!}}Hidden Base]], or [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}Watch Your Step]], or anything in between, if you upgrade to this [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]], it will provide you with benefits. Over the course of the game, you will be able to draw more Force since you won't have to spent any to move here. And against many Dark decks, your opponent will be handicapped by the battle destiny limitation. Does your opponent just have TIEs there?, he only gets one battle destiny.

Combos:

Still only one battle destiny for your opponent!
